title: Playful Boys in Shallow Beach Water, 1972 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage 1972 black-and-white square snapshot capturing two young boys, Kirk and Johnny, playing in the shallow water near a wooden boat pier. Rowboats and motorboats rest anchored in the background, framing a serene summer scene. Handwritten text on the reverse identifies the boys and the month taken (July '72), while the print margin is stamped 'AUG 72' from photo processing.
